review: This iPhone 15 Pro is absolutely amazing! The camera quality is incredible and battery life is fantastic. Best smartphone I've owned.
Terrible experience with the Samsung Galaxy. The screen cracked after just 2 weeks and customer service was completely useless.
Apple's new MacBook Pro with M3 chip is blazing fast. Compiles my code in seconds. The battery lasts all day. Absolutely worth it.
The Sony headphones have excellent noise cancellation and incredible sound quality. However the price at $350 feels a bit high.
The Microsoft Surface Pro deeply disappointed me. The keyboard feels cheap the screen is mediocre and battery barely lasts 4 hours.
Google Pixel 8 has an outstanding camera system. Night photography is phenomenal. Software is clean and fast. Very happy with this purchase.
